_comment: Cited ADS ratios (#552 COWORK #22 §1): ordinary shares per American Depositary Share, as each filer's own LATEST 20-F states it (its 12(b) section, then its text), or an F-6 filed after that 20-F (#552 COWORK #45: an older F-6 never wins), verbatim. Found by scripts/ads-ratio-census.mjs (lib/server/secAdsRatio.ts). A symbol not listed keeps the depositary-share refusal; a ratio is never inferred or defaulted to 1. Read by lib/server/secAdsMap.ts. kind 'ordinary' = the 20-F cover's Section 12(b) row lists ordinary/common shares under the ticker and the filing has no ADS (ratio 1, cited). BBD and CIG are left out: their ADSs are of preferred shares and the quoted line is the common-share ADS. Also left out, by rule: depositary shares of preferred shares or CPOs, and a class ticker (PBR-A, CIG-C) that no 12(b) row names.
